payload.question: An older decision says a merge waits until each requirement's agreed proof has been shown. This work lets a proof you agreed to see only after landing (because it needs the plugin reloaded from main) let the merge through first, and asks for it on the turn after the landing. Does that replace the older rule for those proofs?
